ambient_events: A door slams somewhere up the stairwell and the sound rolls all the way down.
The strip light buzzes, dies for a second, and grudgingly comes back.
description: A cramped ground-floor lobby: a wall of dented mailboxes, half of them hanging open and empty, a buzzer panel with every wire yanked out, and a concrete stairwell that smells of damp, mildew, and somebody else’s dinner three floors up. A strip light overhead flickers like it’s thinking it over.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Lobby
